            candidates.append((list(a_terms), list(b_terms)))

        return a

    def _coprime(a, n):

        if _coprime(b, m): s += 1
        # Structural bonuses
        if (2*a) % m == b: s += 3  # Doubling
        elif (3*a) % m == b: s += 2 # Tripling
        elif (a + 1) % m == b: s += 1 # Consecutive
        return -s # Descending sort

        if _coprime(d, ell): s += 1
        if (2*c) % ell == d: s += 3

        return -s

    B_const_list.sort(key=_score_B)
